S043.name: Restrictive_Intake
S043.description: Persistent restriction of energy intake relative to requirements, leading to significantly low body weight.

subtypes.Eating Very Small Amounts: Eating only one or two bites a day or extremely small portions per meal.
subtypes.Skipping Meals: Intentionally skipping breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
subtypes.Exclusion of Specific Food Groups: Strictly avoiding specific food groups like carbohydrates or fats to prevent nutritional imbalance.
subtypes.Strict Calorie Restriction: Limiting daily caloric intake to an extremely low level.

S044.name: Low_Weight
S044.description: A body weight that is significantly below the minimum level of health for age, sex, developmental trajectory, and physical health.

subtypes.Continuous Weight Loss: A state where weight continues to decrease due to intentional restriction of intake.
subtypes.Insistence on Low Weight: Attempting to lose more weight or refusing to restore weight despite already being underweight.

S045.name: Fear_of_Weight_Gain
S045.description: Intense fear of gaining weight or of becoming fat, even though at a significantly low weight.

subtypes.Fear of Weight Gain: Extreme fear and loathing of gaining weight or becoming fat.
subtypes.Fear of Specific Foods: Fear that eating high-calorie foods will immediately lead to weight gain.
subtypes.Obsession with Weight Gain: Compulsively checking the scale and becoming extremely anxious about even the slightest increase.

S046.name: Body_Image_Weight_Shape_Disturbance
S046.description: Undue influence of body weight or shape on self-evaluation.

subtypes.Distorted Body Image: Perceiving one's body as much fatter than it actually is or perceiving specific parts as excessively large when looking in the mirror.
subtypes.Self-Worth Dependent on Weight: Judging whether one is a good or successful person solely based on weight or body shape.

symptom.disease_info: Anorexia Nervosa is characterized by persistent restriction of energy intake leading to significantly low body weight, accompanied by intense fear of weight gain and a disturbance in how body weight or shape is experienced or valued. It often develops gradually around efforts at control, identity, performance, or perceived health, and is distinguished from other causes of low weight by the central role of weight-gain fear and overvaluation of body shape or weight.

patient.stressor_event: Gaining a new family member (e.g., birth, adoption, older adult moving in)
patient.stressor: When Maria’s elderly mother-in-law moved into the home, Maria reorganized the household around caregiving, work shifts, church obligations, and tightly planned meals, leaving little room for her own needs. At first she skipped portions while cooking for everyone else and praised herself for being frugal and restrained, but over time the restriction became persistent enough that her weight dropped significantly below a healthy level. She increasingly linked her value to staying small and disciplined, worrying that eating more would undo the control she felt she had earned amid a crowded, demanding home life. Maria entered psychiatric care through her primary care clinician, who noticed the weight loss during a routine visit and arranged a referral after Maria acknowledged that fear of gaining weight had begun shaping most of her daily decisions.

S043.name: Restrictive_Intake
S043.description: Persistent restriction of energy intake relative to requirements, leading to significantly low body weight.
S043.manifestation: I cook plates for my husband and my mother-in-law, but by the time I sit down I usually tell myself coffee, a few vegetables, or half a piece of toast is enough for me.

S044.name: Low_Weight
S044.description: A body weight that is significantly below the minimum level of health for age, sex, developmental trajectory, and physical health.
S044.manifestation: My doctor says I've gotten too thin, and I can see my work pants hanging loose on me, but part of me still feels relieved when the number on the scale is lower.

S045.name: Fear_of_Weight_Gain
S045.description: Intense fear of gaining weight or of becoming fat, even though at a significantly low weight.
S045.manifestation: If I eat something heavier, like biscuits or pasta, I spend the rest of the day scared it's going to show on me, so I keep checking myself and thinking I need to make up for it.

S046.name: Body_Image_Weight_Shape_Disturbance
S046.description: Undue influence of body weight or shape on self-evaluation.
S046.manifestation: When I stay small and neat, I feel like I'm handling everything right, but if my stomach looks the least bit full in the mirror I feel like I've let myself go.

add_requirements.functional_impairment: I still get my cleaning shifts done, but I avoid family dinners and church meals now, so my husband says I’m around everyone without really joining in.
